issues.issue: Did the officer apply the proper H&C test by focusing on personalized risk?
issues.applicant_position: Officer's decision wrongly required personalized risk, a s.97 concept, instead of assessing hardship under s.25.
issues.respondent_position: Personalized risk must be shown to establish hardship (Piard), as argued orally; no written submissions.
issues.result_quote: In this case it is virtually the sole matter to which the Officer paid attention. That is an error.

issues.issue: Was the hardship finding on establishment reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Officer listed positive establishment evidence but did not weigh it or analyse hardship.
issues.respondent_position: No written submissions on hardship; relied on personalized risk orally.
issues.result_quote: Where she did so, as in respect to “establishment”, the finding was unreasonable.

issues.issue: Was the best-interests of the children analysis reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Best interests of the children were not properly analysed; the officer's analysis was light.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel acknowledged the best-interests analysis was light; no other position is recorded.
issues.result_quote: This was not done and it was unreasonable to conclude as the Officer did.
